# Project Context

This repository is the **AdventureWorld** project for **Curtin COMP5005 (Postgraduate)**.  
All work must look **human-written by a student**. No visible traces of AI or auto-generated text.

# Hard Rules

- **Plain English only.** No Spanish, no emojis, no accented characters.
- **No AI terms** anywhere: `ChatGPT`, `Copilot`, `OpenAI`, `GPT`, `LLM`, `prompt`, `generated by`, etc.
- **No brochure/marketing words:** `robust`, `scalable`, `leverage`, `state-of-the-art`, `seamless`, `best practices`, `architecture overview`, `pipeline`, `specialized`, `delegate`.
- **Do not change the architecture.** No refactors, no new frameworks. Keep diffs small.
- **PEP-8**; and **avoid** `while True`, `break`, `continue`, `global`.
- **ASCII-only** in UI/console strings.

# Style & Commenting

- **Module docstring:** one short line (what the file does). No banners, no `====`.
- **Class docstring:** one short line (what it manages). Example: “Draws the map and basic KPIs.”
- **Method docstring:** only if non-obvious; otherwise use a short inline comment.
- Prefer small, honest notes:  
  `# NOTE: small delay to keep the UI smooth`  
  `# NOTE: clamp history to avoid growth`
- Remove shebangs (`#!/usr/bin/env python3`) from modules that are not scripts.

# Development Mode

- **Audit-first.** Before proposing changes, check rubric coverage and reproducibility.  
- **Small, incremental diffs.** Do not auto-rewrite files. Keep variable names and formatting natural.  
- **Commit messages** (short, student-like):
  - `fix(metrics): sync abandonment totals in summary`
  - `chore(engine): add reset and pause tests`
  - `test(display): add buffer length check`

# What You May Do

- Add missing docstrings (one-liners) and small inline comments.
- Add/adjust unit tests and tiny bug fixes strictly tied to the brief.
- Tidy obvious issues (unused imports, tiny PEP-8 nits) only where you touch code.

# What You Must Not Do

- No mass reformatting, no global renames, no architectural changes.
- No “technical essays” or generated summaries in code.
- No new dependencies unless explicitly asked.
